page.title: Filtering is Key!
page.body:
Filtering is Key!


Find what you need, faster! Powerful filters help you cut through the clutter and get to your perfect property.

Mastering Your Search on PropertyList.es

PropertyList.es updates results instantly as you adjust your filters. No need to reload pages or submit buttons– just add your desired criteria and watch the perfect properties appear.

1. Location or Referrence # Search:

  • Start by entering a location (city, neighbourhood, area code) or referrence number of the property in the search bar.

Smart Keyword Search: This tool enables you to search precise criteria to find your ideal property quickly and efficiently.

2. Refine with Filters:

  • Unleash the power of filters. Here, you can narrow down your options based on various criteria:
    • Price Range: Set minimum and maximum limits to find properties within your budget.
    • Bedrooms: Specify the desired number of bedrooms and bathrooms.
    • Property Type: Narrow down by specific types like apartments, studios, or commercial spaces.
    • Date Added: Choose this option if you want to see the latest properties uploaded recently.
    • Property Status: Online = Available properties, Offline = Sold or Off market properties.
    • Property Features: An convenient text box lets you select features that matter to you, like Private pool, Frontline Beach, Close to schools etc.
    • Size: Add the m2 of the build, terraces & plot.
    • Car Spaces: Add desired parking spaces for this search.

3. Combine and Conquer:

The beauty lies in combining filters! For example, search for “apartments” in “Marbella” with a price range of “€500,00-€700,000”, “3+ bedrooms”, a “covered terrace” that is “beachside”. This refines your results significantly, saving you time and frustration. 

4. Pro Tips:

Take your search to the next level with Smart Keyword Search: use precise terms like ‘terracotta tiles’ + ‘double glazing’, or specific designers/architects and even finishes and building matterials to refine your results even further.

  • Optimise Your Search with Strategic Keywords! Include specific amenities or nearby landmarks to target your results within property descriptions.

  • Experiment with Filters: Test different combinations to find what works best for you.

  • Save Your Searches: PropertyList.es lets you save frequently used searches for quick access later. See how in the next section.

With these tips, you’ll be a master of searching on PropertyList.es in no time! Happy hunting!
